problems.text: kmctl's release notes list commits that change only the repository's bookkeeping, so a kmaudit-only change shows up in kmctl's notes.

goals.text: Each package's notes list only commits that change what it ships.

outcomes.change: Bookkeeping paths belong to no package, in the notes and in release-tag's late-commit check alike
outcomes.checked_by: release_notes tests that a commit touching only `.okf/` and `uv.lock` is in neither package's notes, one touching `.okf/` and `packages/kmaudit/` is in kmaudit's, and one touching `.claude/` and `docs/` is in kmctl's; `--owns` tests over those path sets; a release-tag test that a late bookkeeping-only commit is not named and a late shipped one is; the workflow step calls `release_notes.py --owns`, with no awk copy of the rule
